correctness.rationale: Prüfer words yield independent length n-2 multinomial rows. Exact coefficient extraction gives the entire pgf and exact marked p and q moments. First-order binomial/multinomial expansions give the distinct-label covariance limit -r(eta-rho)^2. A conditional Poisson Fourier CLT gives Gaussian variance rho(1-rho)-r(eta-rho)^2, strictly positive as a Schur complement; the exact second moment supplies variance convergence. An independently structured standalone verifier passed 249 checks, including the complete finite pgf and enumerated Prüfer words. Remainder bounds and proof limits are explicit in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The number of labels with equal degrees across independent trees is a natural graph-signature comparison invariant, providing a complete finite null law and an explicit nontrivial Gaussian standard error. The negative order-1/n cross-vertex covariance is substantial in the total variance, so a naive independent-indicator approximation is quantitatively wrong. The family for fixed r>=2 has a common mechanism and is not an arbitrary tiny table entry.
